description: This file defines a public enum `CameraCapturePipelineSupport` with various static methods for preparing camera capture sessions, including photo and movie sessions, warming up sessions, error mapping, and capturing photo data. It encapsulates support logic for camera functionalities, utilizing AVFoundation classes and configurations.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for taking photos, selecting the camera device, adding inputs and outputs, and handling errors.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for recording movies, including camera and optional audio input, and configuring outputs.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares and starts a movie capture session asynchronously, warming it up before use.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation with a warmed-up movie session, ensuring the session is stopped afterward.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps a CameraSessionConfigurationError to a more specific custom error, differentiating microphone unavailability.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates and configures AVCapturePhotoSettings with preferred photo format and quality.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a specified delegate, handling the capture process.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Adds a short delay to allow the capture session to stabilize after starting, reducing initial frame issues.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given AVCaptureDevice.Position.
